codes.means: the windowed read gate was not taken within WINDOW_GATE_WAIT_SECONDS; no partition was read
codes.caller_does: wait retry_after_seconds (15) and call the same window again

codes.means: no partition exists at or before as_of for this read; the empty answer is not an error
codes.caller_does: retry with an earlier as_of, or omit as_of

codes.means: no 49F account at this firm ends in the four digits given
codes.caller_does: check the digits or the firm; an answer, not a failure

codes.means: the partition holds no row for this account on that date; the account may exist on other dates
codes.caller_does: retry another as_of, or accept the empty answer

codes.means: 49F serves no model assignment; the weights and the market_value_profile still answer
codes.caller_does: read the weights as the allocation; do not request a model

codes.means: the window holds no fee row for this account
codes.caller_does: report a true zero, or widen the window

codes.means: the firm is not in the canonical set or its aliases (zero reads)
no registered adapter holds this canonical firm (client_resolve_account raises it at :559)
codes.caller_does: no data exists here; do not retry

codes.means: the last-4 given to client_resolve_account is not four alphanumerics
codes.caller_does: send exactly four letters or digits and call again

codes.means: the account is not an account_ref from client_resolve_account (a last-4 or bare number is refused)
codes.caller_does: resolve the account with client_resolve_account first

codes.means: from_date or to_date is missing, unparseable, or reversed
codes.caller_does: pass ISO dates with from_date on or before to_date

codes.means: the window exceeds MAX_WINDOW_DAYS (396, thirteen months)
codes.caller_does: split the window into shorter windows and call each
